summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on the progress of its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 8-12 June 2026, 1,750,000 shares were repurchased at an average price of €25.46, bringing total repurchases to 10,700,000 shares at an average price of €25.67 for €274.7 million, approximately 27.47% of the programme. The buyback aims to reduce share capital. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is mentioned. The programme is ongoing; watch for weekly updates on pace and completion.
